title: The Donkey's Dream
summary: Nasruddin's wife asked: "What do you think our donkey dreams of when it twitches its ears in sleep?"...
full_text:
Nasruddin's wife asked: "What do you think our donkey dreams of when it twitches its ears in sleep?"

"He dreams of a world," smiled Nasruddin, "where fields of sweet clover grow without fences, where pack-saddles are made of marshmallow, and where masters are completely silent!"
moral: Each creature dreams of what brings pure joy to its nature.
